paper.title_en: Opening the Black Box: What Neural Networks Learn from Pulsar Timing Array Data
paper.abstract_en: In recent years, simulation-based inference (SBI) methods have been proposed to address several data-analysis challenges faced by existing and planned gravitational-wave experiments. For example, SBI classification has recently been shown to significantly improve the prospects for detecting anisotropies in pulsar timing array (PTA) data. In this work, we use a simple toy model of a PTA to provide a more pedagogical explanation of how, and under which circumstances, SBI-based detection can improve on classical detection statistics for gravitational-wave background anisotropies.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文聚焦脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）数据分析，用简化玩具模型对基于模拟的推断（SBI）分类方法为何以及在何种条件下优于经典检测统计量给出了教学式解释，方法学上强调可解释性与方法比较，适合PTA方向的研究者点击阅读。
decision.title_zh: 打开黑箱：神经网络从脉冲星计时阵列数据中学到了什么
decision.abstract_zh: 近年来，基于模拟的推断（SBI）方法被提出，用以应对现有和计划中的引力波实验所面临的若干数据分析挑战。例如，SBI分类最近被证明能显著提升在脉冲星计时阵列（PTA）数据中探测各向异性的前景。在本工作中，我们使用一个简单的PTA玩具模型，对基于SBI的探测如何以及在何种情况下能够优于针对引力波背景各向异性的经典检测统计量，提供更具教学性的解释。
